name: Google Chat

tiers.how: Sage receives messages via Cloud Pub/Sub PULL (no public endpoint needed) using `assistant/agent/gchat.py` and sends messages and approval cards through the Chat API. Card button taps require a public HTTPS endpoint, today served by Tailscale Funnel to Mission Control at `/gchat/events`; a 'buttons off' fallback mode accepts approvals as typed words in the thread instead. Requires Google Workspace — a Chat app cannot be built on a consumer Gmail account. Setup runbook: `assistant/agent/GOOGLE_SETUP.md`.
always_tap: any outbound message that initiates a consequential action (not a Sage reply)

gotchas: Requires Google Workspace; a consumer Gmail account cannot host a Chat app.
Card button taps require a public HTTPS endpoint (Tailscale Funnel); without it use 'buttons off' mode where approvals are typed words.
All Chat messages from Sage must pass voice.py before being sent; system-internal cards go to Mission Control only, never to Chat.
Never post personal details or client PII into a team space visible to staff.
notes: Google Chat is Sage's primary notification and approval channel; every outbound action card lands here before any consequential step is taken.
